sources.title: Visa-free countries for Cape Verde
sources.publisher: Portal Único do Governo de Cabo Verde
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government portal describes a positive list of visa-exempt countries; it does not expressly classify ordinary Australian passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This page contains a list of countries whose citizens are exempt from a visa for Cabo Verde.

sources.title: e-Government Djibouti: eVisa information
sources.officialityEvidence: The live government e-Government page proves electronic delivery but not ordinary Australian-passport eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique

sources.title: Liberia Immigration Service: visa on arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Liberia Immigration Service route turns on local embassy availability, and is not an ordinary Australian passport-wide result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa service terms
sources.publisher: Sierra Leone Immigration Department eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: Sierra Leone Immigration Department's live slid.gov.sl page links www.evisa.sl as its Official Portal. The service conflicts on terminal versus electronic issuance and does not identify Australian eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.
